outcome: Using the delivered @exharness/benchmark kernel and calibrated substrate, ExHarness can run reproducible fixed-factor DIRECT_CODEACT versus CORE_SYNC experiments that isolate harness economics without duplicating experiment, attempt, evidence, accounting or audit infrastructure.
currentProblem: The current BB-077 READY plan predates the neutral benchmark package decision and re-owns Harbor integration, run-record/accounting, failure normalization and generic experiment infrastructure. After BB-065, those concerns belong to the shared benchmark kernel/substrate, so BB-077 must return to research and become a thin harness-comparison consumer.
constraints: BB-077 consumes @exharness/benchmark only through its public package root and consumes the calibrated substrate only through the BB-065 substrate manifest/port; it must not deep-import packages/benchmark/src/** or reimplement AttemptLedger, generic evidence, generic accounting, audit or Harbor substrate behavior.
Use the same model/version, task fixture, starting source, prompt/task input, tool surface, evaluator and resource ceilings for matched arm comparisons; only the harness orchestration path may vary.
Every attempt remains in the shared benchmark ledger. Missing provider token/cache/cost observations stay UNKNOWN/null and provider/infrastructure state remains orthogonal to verifier quality.
BB-077 owns synchronous harness economics only. Detached scheduling/cache-stable context/steering capabilities belong to BB-078/079/080 and promotion/held-out ablation belongs to BB-081.
Worker execution requires BB-065 delivery, but RESEARCH_SA may converge the consumer contract before that dependency is DONE.
Public GitHub implementation examples used as canonical evidence must have at least 1,000 stars at evidence check time or be explicitly marked below the threshold.
successCriteria: BB-077 defines DIRECT_CODEACT and CORE_SYNC arm adapters over the exact @exharness/benchmark public contracts and BB-065 substrate manifest, with no local replacement for experiment registration, AttemptLedger, evidence manifests, accounting normalization or audit.

The arm protocol fixes model/task/prompt/workspace/tool/evaluator/budget identities and proves the varying factor is only the direct minimal orchestration path versus createAgentRuntime synchronous Core.

The cohort/dataset/repeat protocol is preregistered, preserves complete attempts, keeps BB-081 held-out tasks inaccessible, and uses the calibrated substrate without requalifying or mutating its generic semantics.

Harness economics are reduced from shared benchmark records into a multidimensional vector including accepted quality, provider cost/tokens when known, model turns, tool calls, elapsed time, cache observations, no-progress/failure fingerprints and repeat consistency without an opaque winner score.

Architectural negatives fail when BB-077 deep-imports benchmark internals, writes generic attempt/evidence/accounting truth directly, implements a second Harbor adapter, bypasses shared audit, or changes product runtime to fit the benchmark.
BB-077 emits a comparison protocol/report contract and held-out handoff that BB-081 can consume without inventing parallel experimental infrastructure or changing the BB-065 kernel.
